headline: Iran claims counter-attacks on US bases in Syria, Oman, and Kuwait
summary: The IRGC claims multiple US soldiers were killed in retaliation for the death of seven Iranian soldiers in a US attack.
details: The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) of Iran has claimed to have carried out counter-attacks on various US bases in Syria, Oman, and Kuwait.
This action was taken as retaliation for a US attack that resulted in the death of seven Iranian soldiers.
The IRGC claims that many US soldiers were killed in these strikes and that they now have full control of the Strait of Hormuz.
Iran has warned that oil and gas exports through the Strait of Hormuz will remain suspended if the US continues its provocative actions.
Reports of attacks in Qatar, Jordan, and Iraq also surfaced, with Jordan intercepting three Iranian missiles.
The situation remains tense as both nations continue to exchange claims of casualties and strategic control.
caption:
Iran's IRGC claims multiple US soldiers killed in counter-attacks across Syria, Oman, and Kuwait.

The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) of Iran has claimed to have carried out counter-attacks on various US bases in Syria, Oman, and Kuwait.

This action was taken as retaliation for a US attack that resulted in the death of seven Iranian soldiers.

The IRGC claims that many US soldiers were killed in these strikes and that they now have full control of the Strait of Hormuz.

Iran has warned that oil and gas exports through the Strait of Hormuz will remain suspended if the US continues its provocative actions.

Reports of attacks in Qatar, Jordan, and Iraq also surfaced, with Jordan intercepting three Iranian missiles.

The situation remains tense as both nations continue to exchange claims of casualties and strategic control.

headline_marked: US and Iran [[trade attacks in return to full-blown war]]
headline: US and Iran trade attacks in return to full-blown war
summary: Tehran targets US assets across the Middle East while Washington hits Iranian infrastructure, marking the biggest escalation since the conflict resumed.
details: The United States and Iran have engaged in a massive exchange of fire, with Tehran targeting American military sites across the Middle East. This represents the largest escalation since the two nations returned to outright war.

Iran accused US forces of striking civilian and energy infrastructure, including an airport, a railway station, and two bridges. Iranian state media reported at least eight dead and 20 wounded in these overnight attacks.

In response, Iran's Revolutionary Guards targeted US radar systems and aircraft in Qatar, as well as radar sites in Oman and an airbase in Bahrain. Qatar reported intercepting a missile attack, while Jordan shot down three Iranian missiles.
The conflict has intensified over the strategic Strait of Hormuz, a key global oil and gas shipping route. The US has reimposed a blockade of Iranian ports to pressure Tehran into a new deal.

Iran's health ministry reports that at least 38 people have been killed and over 400 injured within the country since the fighting resumed. A tanker was also struck by a projectile off the coast of Oman.
China and Pakistan have called for both sides to stop fighting and resume negotiations. However, tensions remain high as both nations refuse to back down over control of the the Strait of Hormuz.
